title: Spanish–Portuguese War (1735–1737)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Spanish–Portuguese War (1735–1737)", at revision 1370748470, opens: "The Spanish-Portuguese War between 1735 and 1737 was fought over the Banda Oriental, roughly present-day Uruguay." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1349425, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1735–1737 war". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
